services.title: Tires and wheels

services.body: Pads, rotors and calipers are checked as a set and the worn ones come off beside the new ones, so you can see what was actually changed.

services.body: Worn steering and suspension parts come off, the replacement goes on beside them, and the alignment is set on the rack afterwards.

reviews.author: Danyalle Wilson
reviews.text: Quick, efficient and cost effective! Would return for any automotive needs. I've had body work from a wreck repaired here, oil changes, brakes replaced and rims exchanged.

reviews.author: Suzanne Earehart
reviews.text: This place is fantastic! Joey and the crew were so friendly & courteous. Service was fast. Amazing prices. 100% would recommend.

reviews.author: Amy Stehle_Loggins
reviews.text: The guys here are.It's so friendly and sweet. They've always helped me, we're right when I'm pulled into the driveway. I passed three or four other tire places on my way and simuns will always be my go to tire places

reviews.author: Delta King
reviews.text: I stopped in today just to check the price of a new set of tires and was greeted by the owner. He was very informative about the warranty and the tire manufacturers location. I was surprised he had my size tires and had all 4 in stock ready to be mounted and balanced. His staff was the most polite and helpful guys and knows exactly what great customer service is! Even cracking a few jokes and I needed those laughs! What a great feeling I left there with knowing I got a great deal and the best customer service I’ve had in decades! Thank you Joey for an awesome job! Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: William F Junemann Jr
reviews.text: Went for rear brakes yesterday. I brought the rotors & pads that I bought from Amazon. The mechanic disassembled everything & of course rotors were wrong size! Grrr. It was then nearing closing time but they managed to order correct rotors, had them delivered & installed new rear brakes relatively quickly, gave me a very fair price and had me outta there by 5:30. If you want a fast efficient brake job or oil change for a good price, Simun's Tire is the place!

reviews.author: Jessie Clay
reviews.text: Wanted to support a local business, and now we are dealing with so many more car issues than ever before. My husband took his car for tires and they told him he also needed tie rods replaced. So, he trusted them and got them replaced. He spent about $530. We thought that was the right thing to do. A few weeks later we needed tires for my car (which is newer), so again supporting a local business we went to Simuns. They put tires on my car and when I drove it home it was very shakey and seemed like it needed an alignment. So, we took it back and told them that we think they knocked my car out of alignment when they replaced my tires. They took my car back into the shop, did not let us see what they were doing as we weren't allowed to come back to watch, then came back out and told us it would be $150 for this fix, BUT we also need tie rods to be replaced as well, just like my husbands car a few weeks ago... it was very sketchy and that's when I knew they were trying to rip off their customers and lie to them about needing something for their car that they actually do not need. We said, no and drove back home... my car is STILL extremely shakey as they did not fix the problem. So, we took my car to a different mechanic who then told us the tie rods on my car were actually fine and that one of the lug nuts on my wheels was stripped from the last person who put tires on my car... so someone at Simuns who clearly did not know what they were doing. Now I am dealing with this all thanks to Simuns. It is incredibly disheartening to have put trust in a local business that scams the neighborhood. We do not have a lot of money so now we are having to wait even longer to get things fixed. Oh and the tires that they put on my husbands car went flat in a matter of two months. They are dishonest and will make up prices on the spot for work that actually does not need to be done. DO NOT GO HERE.

reviews.author: Samantha Clawson
reviews.text: Had the tie rods and ball joints replaced here and within a few months was involved in the most catastrophic vehicle malfunction I have ever seen. They refused to help in any way replace what was damaged. Go to Matt's tire across the street instead of you value your life and car.

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Crittenden
reviews.text: 10/10, if I could give 10 stars I would. These men are trustworthy! They stand up for what's right! They won't let anything poorly happen on their watch. I would drive 3 hours to come back time and time again bc of this !

reviews.author: Donald Huffman
reviews.text: Went there to get a used tire. They gave me the wrong size. When I called to tell them ab it. They said they had another one to replace it. When I get there. They tell me they don't have any more used one. But could sell me a new one. They didn't want replace or refund their mess up. I won't be back and will tell everyone I know. To avoid this place. All they worry about is making money. Not being a honest business that will stand behind their work.

reviews.author: Kenequa Gaskin
reviews.text: Ladies please don’t go here by yourself! I use to really love this place but now they are just greedy and pray on us! I went to see if they could put in a light bulb in my headlight (that i purchased beforehand)…one gentleman went out his way and stated he would check the price before and work is done. He kindly drove my car across the street to the garage and the other gentleman stated to him it would be $40. I kindly accepted and waited on them to finish. Once finished a elder black black man told me the price was $53!! I inquired how and why when i was quoted $40..he seemed confused and didn’t want to investigate so i took it upon myself and found the young gentleman who told me $40 from his boss. They then gave me the price that was quoted in the first hand! (AS THEY SHOULD!) Ladies be aware, this isn’t the first time ive been up charged for a service here which is why I’m now I’m telling the rest now. If it wasn’t for that kind young gentleman I’d give this place 0 stars if i could!

reviews.author: Trevor Porsche
reviews.text: I went to simuns tire and brake to get tires replaced and the so called mechanic stripped out the wheel studs and lug nuts. Do not take your car here because the repair bill will be overpriced and extremely expensive.

reviews.author: Phillip Gonzalez
reviews.text: Been twice: first for a new tire and again a few days later for a new spare, oil change, and alignment. These guys are friendly, affordable, fast, and do good work. Can’t ask for much else. Will be back.

reviews.author: Miz Erie
reviews.text: I first found Simun Tires years ago because I needed new brake pads and was broke. They told me I could buy the pads (because I wanted the really cheap ones not worth buying) and they'd put them on for cheap. I don't know if they still do that because I just let them handle all of it now (I don't think they do), but let me tell you what I know they do: they treat their customers right! I don't trust anyone but Joey and his guys with my cars now. I've had them tell me "This isn't a simple fix; it's going to cost you," but I've also taken them what I thought was going to be an expensive repair for them to say, "Oh it's not insert-big-problem; it's just this little fix." And just this week, they saved me again. My car broke down in Columbia. I thought I had no option but to try to get it repaired there. The shop I took it to tried replacing the alternator, but that made it worse. They weren't sure what the problem was, but when I made a suggestion based on my own research, they insisted that couldn't be the problem. Fed up, I called Simun and talked to Joey. We made a plan for his tow truck to pick my car up at the other shop in Columbia and tow it back to Simun in Greenville. Joey called me the next day to let me know the problem and the cost. Funny enough, it was exactly what the other shop insisted it couldn't be, the voltage regulator. I okayed the price and Joey's guys got on it. My car was fixed within three days of my initial call to Joey about towing my car back from Columbia. And including the 100-mile tow, it only cost me a little over what the other shop was going to charge me for just an alternator! And I know from experience Joey stands behind the work his guys do. Don't listen to the reviews saying negative things; I'm assuming those people either don't know anything cars or car repairs and/or they're wanting work done for an unreasonably low rate. I rarely drive by Simun when their lot isn't full. Joey runs a thriving business with multiple locations, which requires repeat customers like me. And customers don't return to businesses that don't treat them right and do good work!

reviews.author: MrWhiteSR21
reviews.text: Do not listen to the bad reviews when they are saying that are crooks and they are rude none of these accusations are true, nine times out of ten Joey didn’t give them a good enough price to suit them or they tried to get over on them and it didn’t work in their favor.I am very picky with who touches my vehicles and if I come to them then they are very good at what they do. I’ve been coming here for 8 years for tire, brake, and mechanical repairs as well and I’ve never had an issue with the owner or his employees every location that Joey owns their customer service and their work is always quality. Simuns gets the job done right the first time at a reasonable time and price.

reviews.author: Star McGowan
reviews.text: I highly recommend this place! Consistently great, professional service. Service is always quick. Prices are the best in town. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Karen Davis
reviews.text: Honestly, I have been going to this place for years. However, this time when I went, there was some older black man that did not know how to communicate. Although we were apologized to after the fact that is just not how you do business by talking to people any kind of way.

reviews.author: Tina M
reviews.text: This place is an absolute joke! I would highly recommend going elsewhere. We took a pair of tires to be mounted and balanced. They didn’t clean the old bead seal off, in order to seal the tire correctly. So we went back two times after this to try to get them to correct the situation to be told on the third visit back to the shop (because the tires are still leaking air after the mount and balance job) to be told that they needed to be redone completely and would cost an additional $80! We had already paid $100 to have two tires mounted and balanced, and value stems replaced so why should we have to pay an additional $80?! Poor customer service, and a shop that can’t own up to their mistakes! I would avoid these people at all cost. This is highway robbery at its finest! Update on previous review. So we went to a more credible shop and found out that the reason the tire in question was not holding air was due to corrosion and a big hole in rim. Now the guys at Simuns never mentioned this to us and had of seen it while mounting the tire. Yet they wanted to charge another $100? For what something that wasn’t fixable?? I mean no disrespect, and I’ve always heard good things about Simuns in the past but I’ve heard this is not the same place it use to be from several other individuals I know and trust . Please buyer beware!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text: After being grossly overcharged for a plug from NTB I was referred to Simuns by a friend. I went there and was given EXCELLENT & super fast service. My tire plug was done very professionally and more than reasonably priced! Bryan was who helped me today. He was very kind and fast! I would want him to work on my car again. Thank you for running such a HONEST professional business. I will only come to you from now on, and i will refer everyone I know to you.

reviews.author: Thalia Lopez
reviews.text: Got my brakes and front rotors done for a great price, went shopping around before but should've known to come to Simun First. Workers did a great job and they were on point with everything done to the car. Great customer service from everyone and wonderful experience will recommend always.

reviews.text: Went for tires and an alignment. The guy who walked up turned around and his boss for the price and then then walked off 10 mins later the tires were off my truck and new ones put on, 20 mins later and two other cars he walks up and then finds out I wanted an alignment and then lays on the ground for 15mins then disappears for 30min and comes back to say some is wrong with with parts just put on. So now I’m sitting in another tire shop getting an alignment fillin this out to say if the tall dark skin guys with gold teeth walks up to your car drive off

reviews.author: Bob Duncan
reviews.text: This place is an absolute joke. They change their prices every time you go. They just make it up. And every used tire is a piece of crap and then they get pissed when you have to take their crap back to them. DO NOT GO THERE!!!!! and all females please stay away... they prey on you the most!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Aaron Poston
reviews.text: Tire rotation and balance was perfect with no issues. Also had a bad stud and lug issue but guys were fast and efficient getting it fixed.

reviews.author: Nisha Talley Nicholson
reviews.text: Great prices! He changed all of my brake pads with his in house products and put 4 new tires on in less than 45 minutes. He also didn't make me pay for any unnecessary work. I'm big on customer service and he now has a loyal customer in me.

reviews.author: Lisa Smith
reviews.text: This was a very nice place to go. It was my intention to have my donut removed in order to discover what was wrong with my original tires and have them repaired and reinstalled. Since they found nothing wrong with the original tire, they replaced it with the original tire, put the donut back on, and did not charge me anything.

reviews.author: Marius Fuller
reviews.text: Went in the shop yesterday to get an oil change , alignment . Was told I needed new tire rods on the passenger side of my caddy cts . I said ok do it . The price was 545 all said and done . Not only is my alignment worse than when I went in , I have a wobble in my steering . I go down the street to get new tires and got laughed at for the money I spent vs the work done . Was told by the second shop they would have done both sides with new tire rods and alignment for less . I haven’t had the chance to go back but they open at 8am and I will have a word with someone about a refund for my alignment.

reviews.author: Susan Evans
reviews.text: Almost always very busy! But they will get you in and out quickly. They do excellent work and I recommend them to my friends. Wonderful price for tires for my car and an oil change. Will be going back as soon as its time for my next oil change.

reviews.author: Marlanea Fowler
reviews.text: Absolutely one if the best tire shops around for working people on a budget. All the staff were so kind. They did all 4 tires so fast. I have had tires 2-3weeks absolutely no problems. I am a very satisfied customers and will send my entire family and friends.

reviews.author: Brad Harvey
reviews.text: Corey was the technician that assisted me. He took his time and made sure that everything was exactly to my liking and even pulled one of my front wheels back off to check my brakes after he had finished the job. A1 customer service and great prices! I would recommend them to everyone!

reviews.author: Pauline Miller
reviews.text: Got a fuel pump done there for 400.00 and the fuel pump isn't good this happened this year now the manager Joey said there is a two year warranty and if any problems they'll fix it . Took car back up there they miss diagnosised it for something totally unrelated to their previous work come to find out it's still the fuel pump.honestly I'm afraid they gonna eff the car up more to do what they didn't do in the beginning but nobody got 400. To be throwing away. I want my car done right and for the price it should have been done correctly. I got my receipt and I will be taking them to court if they dont honor the 2 year warranty. I don't recommend anyone to take their car to them if they expect the job to be done correctly. You could loose your life and you definitely gonna loose your money. And I don't say that lightly looking at these reviews. Please do your research cause I did not and I'm paying for it now..And if you got good sense stand up there and watch them if you know something about cars or youll be sorry .

reviews.author: Sheila Tooley
reviews.text: I stopped by needing front tires, not having much time to spare due to work hours. Joey had me ready to ride in 15 minutes. Very friendly atmosphere and LOW PRICES. I definitely will be a return customer.

reviews.author: HoneyDew Drop
reviews.text: Best $40 tires this side of Greenville hands down. Had to do my alignment three times and still made my SUV drive worse than when I initially brought it. Just good for tire changes.

reviews.author: Bobby Smith
reviews.text: I was there today the guy working was very friendly and helpful. Spoke to the Boss about a previous problem not want anything for me just trying to help with future customers. He did not want to listen and gave quick answer. They need to slow down and work on quality and customer service.

reviews.author: Michelle Jorgensen
reviews.text: I had the coils changed out and a tune-up done on 1/27/23. Asked for OEM parts SEVERAL times. Did not receive an invoice when I left--just the credit card slip. Car was okay for about two weeks, then light came back on and it began to misfire. Took to another mechanic who could see from outside that OEM parts were not used, they charged by $40 for this information. Found out they did not use Ford parts (for which I paid $750 for parts and labor). Went back and was given a hand-written receipt w/ date of 2/23/2023. Confronted Joey and was told to bring it back and that they would fix. Told him in front of employees and customers that they would never touch my car again. I've worked for Ford Motor for 23 years, and this place is unprofessional at best. Will see him in small claims court. Suggest you RUN to the next shop and stay far from this one. Update: called the business and quoted $250 for labor. Bought original parts for $105 with tax from a dealer. So, cost should have been $355 total, charged $750. Also, be aware they will offer you 6% discount if you pay cash aka dollar bills.

reviews.author: Lovey
reviews.text: Simuns Tire and Brake is a very horrible business to go take your car too, please learn from the experience as well as others who have rated them in the review section and on the Better Business Bureau web page. Below I have pictures of what I said when I filed a complaint with the BBB it explains it. I want to say the owner name is Joey, I believe a James is there too, but the owner Joey is a very bad unprofessional business person and does not have any regards to you or your families life when it comes to repairs on your car, if he and his crew don’t repair your brakes correctly or whatever you’re having repairs too, he won’t be a man and man up to the mistake they made, he will speak to you crazy when you are confronting him as to what it is they messed up, so with that being said, I’m telling folks please don’t take your car there. And for those that have gotten their cars back and him and his crew messed your car up, go on the Better Business Bureau website and report him so that it can help others.

reviews.author: Roy Johnson
reviews.text: In the last 2 months these reviews have went down hill and I see why. No communication. They are a tire shop and from the reviews on the last 2 months not a good one anymore. This is the third time they've had my car family Auto send me there. If I had to pay for it I definitely would not have sent my car here buyer definitely beware

reviews.author: Francisco Cuello Lugo
reviews.text: Great Tire Shop Got 4 Used Tires From This Short Young Guy And He Was Very Quick and Respectful! You Need To Go To This Tire Shop

reviews.author: LaShunda Acosta
reviews.text: The owner, Joey, is very unprofessional, rude, & disrespectful to his customers. They service you so quick, that they don't do the job correctly and/or they misdiagnose your vehicle. I see that most reviews state that they are thrilled about the quick service they received, but it is better (and more important) to have the CORRECT diagnosis & the job done RIGHT the 1st time & receive friendly, respectful, and professional communication from the owner - Joey (especially when you the customer is being professional & respectful); instead of the owner -Joey- cursing you (the customer) out because his employees messed up.

reviews.author: Jamie Nelson
reviews.text: Paid $975 in work for something That they repaired to come loose Within 2 weeks after repairing. I’m glady going to pay someone else to do it right because of the hassle they gave me before. Not to mention that they never got back with me about the replacement rim they were suppose to find so after riding on a donut for a week I took matters into my own hands. They do enough of a job just to get you by. I’m not a new customer but I certainly should have paid attention to the smaller signs when I was a new customer. They get over on women and customer service is terrible, they only care about the money. The fact that they know I have kids and did not repair my car properly is very unsafe. Would not recommend!

reviews.author: Jeremiah Thornton
reviews.text: Don't live up to they warranty. Spent $300 on a tire that went bad in a couple weeks. Told me it was my rim when it really was the tire they sold me

reviews.author: Keisha Holmes
reviews.text: This Place was ok for the price of the tires but the owner will take advantage of a woman..I paid for tires & alignment..I took my car back 3 Times.. For the owner and his worker to lie to me about my car having a alignment..so I took it to Another mechanic whom I trust to be told that the alignment was not done correctly..They have so many customers they are rushing on fixing your car and don’t complete the service correctly. If u want your vehicle to be fixed correctly I definitely would not recommend this place to anyone!! Bad business

reviews.author: Patrick Downs
reviews.text: Good place to go if you need a quick fix for a tire or to get some tires. Few times had my jacked up too high and nearly slipped off the jack from inexperienced ppl but giving them room to learn and grow is what a job is about. But other than that this is my go to spot to get tires and plug tires if needed.

reviews.author: Artou Rousselle
reviews.text: Simuns Tire and Brake is a great neighborhood mechanic shop. They do more than tires and brakes so don't hesitate to ask about there other services and pricing! They move through the work quick and efficient so if they dont have a spot come back in a bit and you'll be worked right in!

reviews.author: Travis VanDewark
reviews.text: Ive done business with these folks ever since I can remember. Never really had any problems but if I did on the rare occassion ut was always made right. I mean you can only do so much with a set of used tires at 20-30.00 a piece. If you want super perfection order some new tires from them and get em balanced proper etc. Ive got no complaints and will continue frequenting them for my tires and light mechanical needs.

reviews.author: Anthony Reynolds
reviews.text: They were very busy . We purchased two used tires . (Barely used) . They got us in and out quickly . Very pleased with the whole deal . Price, service and attn. To details. Will return and recommend. Thanks!

reviews.author: Laura Smith (Trixie Bizarre)
reviews.text: Fast, Friendly staff and CRAZY DEALS on used tires! Even hard to find sizes (like 15" truck tires!)! And these used tires are not scary like the ones I saw at a store on the east end of main street in Easley. They have great deals on new tires too! I grew up in a salvage yard. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this shop.

reviews.author: TURN-UP TURNER
reviews.text: One of the best places in the Upstate in my opinion. Christmas Eve, and they were closing up shop, but the owner, Joey Simun, still managed to make sure my front brakes got put on! Talking about customer appreciation & service! Turn Up Turner highly recommends this awesome company!!!

reviews.author: Tameka Wellmaker
reviews.text: I went in and had 2 new tires, brake pads that I brought, and a wheel alignment done on my car. Then a new set of tires on my daughters car. Asked that the old brake pads be put in the car to return to the part store, but the guy didn’t. Called back and now they’ve been put in a scrap pile without a box. Asked the owner to refund $38 for the brakes and he declined after I paid him $565!!! Cool, I won’t be going back! Not about the money at all, it’s the principle when you’re doing business!

reviews.author: Maria Ballard
reviews.text: I'm always pleased with their professionalism... Very kind, helpful, and even joke around with you. I never had any problems with any tires I have bought from them! Go here before you choose anyone else!!!

reviews.author: Brookelyn Mitchell
reviews.text: DO NOT GO TO THIS SHOP!!!! One of Simun’s employees did not close my hood on my vehicle after getting my oil checked. I got on the highway and my hood flew open and shattered my windshield and dented the top frame of my car as well as messed up my hood. The owner and his son are both very rude and gave me a hard time and the run arounds about fixing my vehicle. I drove a week before they replaced the windshield. It’s been 2-3 weeks and my vehicle’s body work is still not fixed. I have called and came to the shop numerous of times and the owners son stated that “my dad has other shops and more important things to do other than worry about your little vehicle.” I don’t recommend this company to ANYONE!

reviews.author: Bryan Lee
reviews.text: Fast and good prices.....BUT ..... I bought two tires and after about 300 miles one of them came apart. Theres no guarantees or warranties .....i should of gotten the cheap walmart tire for twenty more dollars. I included pics of the tire

reviews.author: Nolan Gilbertson

reviews.author: Kimberly Golightly
reviews.text: Was in need of 3 good but used tires today, so I got to asking around & had 3 people tell me to go to Simon Tire! Well I did & i'm super happy that I went.. Joey Simun was there and got it done with the help of his employees. I was only there maybe 10 mins or less! Awesome customer service, everyone was friendly & I will most definitely will be coming back in the future.. also will be spreading the word around to everyone else!

reviews.author: Jessie Walters
reviews.text: These guys changed my brakes and rotors in less than an hour and charged me over half the price that Midas would have charged me. They were friendly, fast, and saved my day and my wallet.

reviews.author: Drake Waldrop

They didn't offer to knock off a few dollars and I missed two days of work because

reviews.author: L. E. Smith
reviews.text: This tire shop has always done me right! I was going to get price on tires whether they're new or used. They can often get hard-to-find sizes! I always have my 31 10.50 15 tires when I need them!

reviews.author: Asia Sewell
reviews.text: If you need anything done trust go to them they do everything tires, mechanic stuff, and towing. They open everyday except Sunday. And they work is amazing. And they quick. Hands down best shop I have found

reviews.author: K. Washington
reviews.text: It's a good place if your funds are low and you need a good use tire. They also sell new tires, they offer brake jobs, tune ups, a/c serv. and alignments. They are very nice, courteous and fast.

reviews.author: Alissa G
reviews.text: Had my car towed here because of a blow out. They gave me a great deal on a brand new set of tires and the service was super fast! I will definitely be recommending Simuns!

reviews.author: Rayfus Hagood
reviews.text: I went it to have my control arm replaced on my vehicle in June. Paid for the part only for them to tell me that I needed a lower ball joint on my passenger side control arm. The ball joint they replaced on my vehicle came out of place causing my CV axle to break and messed up my front fender of my vehicle. I paid 83 for the part and 357 dollars for labor. I called to let the owner Joey know what happened but never got a reply. The mechanic peewee who did the job got an attitude when I told him what happened and hung up on me. Mind you I only had the part for 7 months that they paid for. Please be aware when doing business with them. Jobs may not be don't correctly.

reviews.author: Robbie Dogg
reviews.text: Everybody needs to Holla at Joey for all their automotive needs, from tires to rims, engine work, brake work or even towing services. He's honest, fair and always trying to help someone out

reviews.author: RTH Falconer
reviews.text: I have not personally visited this facility, but after watching the video footage of the way the owner held local police accountable for using brutal tactics during a routine arrest, you have earned my patronage.
